caseName: Bank of China v. NBM L. L. C.
caseNameFull: Bank of China, New York Branch v. NBM L. L. C.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Did the Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit err when it held that civil Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations Act plaintiffs alleging mail and wire fraud as predicate acts must establish ‘reasonable reliance’ under 18 U.S.C. § 1964(c)?”
